newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hardie to build $A50 million plant.
newsitem.headline: Hardie to build $A50 million plant.

text.p: Building materials producer James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Monday it had formed a joint venture with Jardine Davies Inc to build a A$50 million fibre cement plant in the Philippines.

The joint venture, to be called Hardie Jardine Inc, will begin work early next year on construction of a fibre cement plant south of with an annual production capacity of 20 million standard metres, equivalent to half the current Australian market for fibre cement.

The plant, which is expected to be fully operational by mid-1998, will produce fibre cement building boards for internal and external lining applications for the Philippines' burgeoning residential construction industry, the company said.
James Hardie will own two-thirds of the joint venture.
